decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-9f3945740531] states the exact rename: the metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_failure` is now `envoy_cilium_npds_update_failure`. [ev-77f05428497a] adds that this is part of renaming the prefix of all Envoy NPDS (NetworkPolicy discovery service) metrics from `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_` to `envoy_cilium_npds_` in 1.17. That gives the subject, the change type and its replacement. It also shows who is exposed: deployments that use Cilium's Envoy NPDS metrics and refer to the old per-node name. The evidence does not name a configuration setting that controls whether these metrics are emitted. The real gap is that no Cilium configuration check can express "monitoring uses the old name". This is a limit of the condition language, not missing evidence, so a reviewer should route it, not ask for more evidence.
